claim_boundary: This is one terminal low-capacity radial-source research experiment. It changes only the fixed radial representation of the unchanged official MACE-POLAR four-channel source. It cannot reopen the original 1.5-A source profile, select an energy ledger, or admit E/F/H/V/M.

constraints: one universal mixture for all elements and atoms
one universal mixture for l=0 and every l=1 component
strictly positive convex weights summing to one
each atom-centred monopole and dipole is exactly preserved
no geometry, root, cavity, solvent, or experimental-label dependence

candidate_grid.construction: baseline is the single 1.5-A primitive; weight 1.0 is a single narrow primitive; all other candidates mix the narrow primitive with 1.5 A

selection.blindness_note: The held-out records are excluded from parameter selection but their historical point-multipole outcomes already exist; this is not a prospectively blind test.
selection.objective: mean over training compounds of squared quadrature-weighted relative L2 MEP error
selection.tie_break: smaller fixed embedding distance from the original 1.5-A representation, then lexical candidate ID
forbidden_selection_inputs: any solvation total or CDS/SMD term

terminal_decision.failure: Close this radial-embedding branch and transition to a scalar-first or independent variational polarization model. Do not add element-specific, geometry-dependent, or energy-fitted patches.
terminal_decision.success: Freeze the selected map as a new source profile. This authorizes ledger decomposition work only; it does not inherit original-profile force evidence or admit any capability.
